sectors.name: Technology
themes: Enterprise AI adoption is accelerating, driving durable demand for cloud, cybersecurity, and data analytics platforms regardless of macro swings.

For local exposure, RUNS and YELO offer momentum but liquidity is thin—take profits into strength. Maintain WATCH; add on any IDX tech dip below 5% from recent highs.

themes: Indonesia's renewable buildout is accelerating on the new RUPTL and NRE law implementation, favoring local EPC and IPP names with project pipelines.

Rotate toward utilities with regulated returns (PCG, EIX) for carry. Trim KEEN after the pop. Watch for Indonesia's next RUPTL revision as the catalyst to add exposure.
